title: statusline r7 AIE: stdin two-run oracle does not falsify stdin-read
description: Round 7. Lens: ai-engineer (validator: PE). Owner: SO session. Defect: byte-identity across populated/absent stdin proves invariance, not non-consumption — a read-with-fallback segment passes whenever fed JSON coincides with snapshot fields (the natural fixture-authoring case); the same passage rejects determinism oracles for fan-out then uses one here; the populated stdin JSON is also an unenumerated corpus input. Citations verified: contract:163, :188, :173. Proposed: resolved-candidate (stdin-bytes-read-equals-zero counter at the effectful-shell seam, matching the acquisition-count pattern; plus the stdin fixture member enumerated with sentinel values disjoint from the snapshot).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed: stdin enforced by count — the effectful-shell seam counts stdin bytes read, statusline path reads zero (matching the acquisition-count pattern the reviewer cited); sentinel-stdin fixture (display-field values disjoint from every snapshot field) enumerated as a corpus member backing the count with an output-level check. Revision: Status detection criterion + fixture corpus.
